items.t: Susquehanna Maintains Positive on StoneCo, Lowers Price Target to $12
items.sum: Susquehanna analyst James Friedman maintains StoneCo (NASDAQ:STNE) with a Positive and lowers the price target from $15 to $12.

items.t: Shares of integrated oil and gas companies are trading lower amid energy price declines after Iran's foreign minister said that the government has agreed to an accelerated two-day timeline to reopen the Strait of Hormuz that could be enacted if the U.S. meets its demands.
